Foreword
ThisisaboutsomeinterestingRealtek-basedcommercialPoEswitches.
1. ExtraBTportsforpower-hungryPDs
2. Comboportsforflexiblecombination
3. Auto-detectingPDvoltage(Especiallyusefulinpowering24VPDs,refertoPassivePoEfile)
Thosemodelsareusuallyforsomespecificscenarios.
Belowissomesimpleexplanationofthefeatures.
 Whereis802.3btPoEused?
802.3btprotocolincludestype3(60W)andtype4(90W)output,ourmodelssupportboth.
Itsmainlyaboutsomepower-demandingdevicessuchasPTZcameras,smartLEDsetc.
Typicalexample:
PTZcamerasatthemainentranceofindustrialparks,residenceareas.
Camerashereusuallycarrymorenetworkingdataandplayacrucialroleinthemonitoringsystem,sohigh-
powerPTZorDomecamerasareadopted.
 WhyareComboportspopular?
AcomboportmeansthatyoucanuseeithertheRJ45portortheSFPportatanygiventime,onlyoneofthe
portswillbeactive.
Ifport1&2arecomboports,whenyouuseport1,port2willbeinactive.
Itallowsuserstohaveflexibleportcombinationsonthesamemodelandrealizesversatilityinnetwork
deployments.
 Auto-detectingPDvoltage
TherearemanyPDswithvariouspowerinputlike24Vor48V,itsalmostinevitableinamajornetworking
system.
Intypicalapplication,aPoEsplitterisrequiredtoseparatethepowerfromthePoEportsfor24VPDs,this
increasesthecostthecablingtrouble.
WeareintroducingAutomodelsandrealizeauto-detectingandpowering.WhenPoEportsareworking,it
firstdetectsthePDvoltage,thenitsmartlysupplies24Vor48VvoltagetoPDswithoutexternalintervention.

FAQ
 Leadtime
1. Productiontimeisusually5~7workingdaysforstandard(non-customized)models(nomorethan50pcs).
2. Shippingtimeisusually4~7daysbyair
3. Intotal,ittakes10~15daysforaclienttoreceivetheorder.
 Shipment
1. Wewillsendthegoodsbyair(DHL,UPSorFEDEX)orbysea(forbulkorder)
2. Itisfinetoshippurchaseditemsviacustomer’sshippingaccountorforwarder.
 MOQ
1. 1Pc/Pair(ItisNOTfree,SagaTelecomdoNOTdoFREESAMPLES)
2. Itisfinetohavesampletestingbeforebulkorder,but1Pc/PairisONLYaboutsampletesting.
3. Whentestingprovesfine,MOQis20pcs(discussionisrequiredifitisaboutsmallerquantity).
 Warranty
1. 1yearforcommercialmodels(STCseries)and3yearsforindustrialmodels(STIseries)
2. Pleasekindlyrefertothe“WarrantyPolicy”formoreinformation.
